name: Mont Ventoux
note: Forest, then a bare moonscape and wind. It's the best showcase for dynamic weather.

name: Alpe d'Huez
note: Numbered hairpins and crowds, and the most famous climb in cycling.

name: Stelvio
note: Hairpins stacked up a mountain, with snow walls at the top.

name: Athens Marathon route
note: History, a steady climb and a finish inside a marble stadium.

name: Haleakalā
note: Sea level to above the clouds at sunrise, one of the longest continuous paved climbs anywhere.

name: Paris–Roubaix sectors
note: The best ride for feeling the surface through the bike.

name: Olympus Mons
note: Nobody else has it. Riding on Mars is the kind of thing that gets talked about.

name: Giza Pyramids and Cairo
note: A wonder of the world from the saddle.

name: Gavia
note: The 1988 snowstorm stage is a natural fit for a weather mode.
